title: Finite bounded-constructible evaluation of the proper/open system scalar mate
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an embedding $\iota:E\to L$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism and $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{p}Y)$ a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], with $Z$ and $Y$ Noetherian. Use the actual quotient-system derived categories and their scalar-extension functor $S_X$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], the actual proper/open mate $e_c=\operatorname{systemCompactScalar}_{\iota,c}$ [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization], and the intrinsic bounded constructibility predicate [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. For an arbitrary derived system $N$ on $X$ and a single index $n\geq0$, suppose that $\operatorname{ev}_{E,n}N$ and $\operatorname{ev}_{L,n}(S_XN)$ are bounded constructible. Then $\operatorname{ev}_{L,n}(e_c(N))$ is invertible. The two coefficient rings at this index are $\mathcal O_E/(\pi_E^{n+1})$ and $\mathcal O_L/(\pi_L^{n+1})$ with their specified embedding-induced quotient map. There is no assumption that $N$ is cartesian, complete, or bounded uniformly in the index, and no inverse-limit conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem systemCompactScalar_evaluation_isIso
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    [IsNoetherian c.Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E X) (n : ℕ)
    (hN : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X
      ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).obj N))
    (hS : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l L (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X
      ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l L X n).obj
        ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι X).obj N))) :
    IsIso ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l L Y n).map
      ((systemCompactScalar l E L ι c).app N))
